title: Approve a composition
question: Scenario Broadcast Crawl is locked. Which composition should we build? Say what should carry forward or feels false.

options.label: Crawl-docked prompt
options.thesis: Numbered Boon list owns the center; dual seats stay PIP; the phosphor crawl dominates the bottom third.
options.viewport: Match Draft: channel header, small West/East PIPs, vertical broadcast choices, heavy crawl dock.
options.risk: Lobby continuity is implied, not shown — Match grammar must still stretch to Home/Lobby.
options.case: Strongest Draft Operate focus for the whole-app Fusion HUD.

options.label: Dual-seat on-air stage
options.thesis: Equal West/East seat windows frame a center SELECT stack — Draft and fight share one stage grammar.
options.viewport: Three-column Match: seat meters + loadout, numbered Boon system boxes, thin crawl.
options.risk: Invented Draft timer and decorative Greek noise must not ship; product has no pick timers.
options.case: Best continuity from Draft into live fight seats.

options.label: Greenroom + on-air PIP
options.thesis: Lobby is the control room; Match appears as ON AIR PIP so Home/Lobby/Match share chrome from day one.
options.viewport: Host panel + Start Match, join rows, channel guide, Match preview PIP, event crawl.
options.risk: Fake viewer/bitrate telemetry is costume — strip claims; keep broadcast chrome only.
options.case: Best whole-app Fusion proof; Draft density lives in the PIP until Match phases expand it.
